race.comment: REVOLVER (8) found the line nicely to grab second last time out over 1700m at Geelong. Has a win and two placings at this journey from four starts. Sure to be putting in the big strides late again. BOLD STRIKE (2) is third up today. Turned in a better run last time when second, beaten a nose, at Ararat over 1600m. Goes very well at this journey, boasting two wins from four starts and shapes as a key runner. CATCH THE MOON (9) ran a better race last start to finish a close third over 1700m at Warrnambool after being prominent at the bend. Well placed and there is no reason he cannot find winning ways. KURAKKA (1) had a consistent prep last time in without winning and while well held first up, he'll be better for it and is suited up to this trip.
